svg.text: Choptuik echo period Δ(D) of massless scalar critical collapse
93 computed solutions, D = 3.7 to 31.3; the 72 pinned points (D ≤ 25.5) carry the fits, hollow points are not pinned yet
Δ levels off at a finite value instead of falling to zero
Against 1/√(D−2) the curve runs into a finite intercept
Local exponent −d ln Δ / d ln(D−2) peaks near D ≈ 7, then falls
Δ from spectral multiple shooting (solver/README.md); hover a point for its value, a curve for its coefficients
